_meta.name: Trooth Pre-Flight Control Catalog
_meta.note: Checks run against the resolved intent of infrastructure-as-code (Terraform plan JSON, Pulumi preview JSON, or CloudFormation/CDK templates), normalized to a common resource shape. Each check maps a code-defined control to recognized frameworks and ships a Fix-It remediation. Advisory only — Trooth never applies changes; the engineer merges the suggested patch.

checks.title: S3 bucket must enforce server-side encryption
checks.rationale: Unencrypted object storage exposes data at rest if the bucket is compromised.
checks.fix: Add a aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration resource (AES256 or aws:kms) for this bucket.

checks.title: S3 bucket must block public access
checks.rationale: Publicly readable/writable buckets are the #1 cause of cloud data breaches.
checks.fix: Set ACL to private and add aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block with all four block_* flags = true.

checks.title: RDS instance must be encrypted at rest
checks.rationale: Unencrypted databases expose all stored records if the storage layer is accessed.
checks.fix: Set storage_encrypted = true (and optionally kms_key_id) on the aws_db_instance.

checks.title: RDS instance must not be publicly accessible
checks.rationale: A publicly reachable database is exposed to the entire internet.
checks.fix: Set publicly_accessible = false and place the instance in private subnets.

checks.title: EBS volume must be encrypted
checks.rationale: Unencrypted block storage exposes data at rest.
checks.fix: Set encrypted = true on the aws_ebs_volume.

checks.title: Security group must not expose SSH/RDP to the world
checks.rationale: 0.0.0.0/0 ingress on ports 22 (SSH) or 3389 (RDP) invites brute-force and lateral movement.
checks.fix: Restrict the ingress CIDR to known admin ranges or a bastion/VPN; remove 0.0.0.0/0 on 22/3389.

checks.title: IAM policy must not grant Action:* on Resource:*
checks.rationale: Wildcard admin grants violate least-privilege and turn any credential leak into full account compromise.
checks.fix: Scope the policy to the specific actions and resource ARNs the workload needs.

checks.title: Load balancer listener must use HTTPS/TLS
checks.rationale: Plain HTTP listeners transmit data unencrypted in transit.
checks.fix: Set protocol = "HTTPS" (port 443) with an ACM certificate_arn, and redirect HTTP→HTTPS.

checks.title: CloudWatch log group should be encrypted
checks.rationale: Logs can contain sensitive data and should be encrypted with a KMS key.

checks.title: GCS bucket must not be public (no allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers)
checks.rationale: Granting allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers makes a GCS bucket world-readable.
checks.fix: Remove allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers IAM members and enable uniform bucket-level access + public access prevention.

checks.title: Cloud SQL must not be publicly reachable
checks.rationale: Enabling a public IPv4 with an authorized network of 0.0.0.0/0 exposes the database to the internet.
checks.fix: Set ipv4_enabled = false (use private IP) or restrict authorized_networks; never authorize 0.0.0.0/0.

checks.title: GCP firewall must not open SSH/RDP to 0.0.0.0/0
checks.rationale: source_ranges of 0.0.0.0/0 on ports 22/3389 exposes admin access to the world.
checks.fix: Restrict source_ranges to known admin CIDRs; remove 0.0.0.0/0 on 22/3389.

checks.title: Azure Storage must require HTTPS and block public blobs
checks.rationale: Storage accounts that allow public blob access or non-HTTPS traffic expose data at rest and in transit.
checks.fix: Set enable_https_traffic_only = true and allow_blob_public_access = false (or allow_nested_items_to_be_public = false).

checks.title: Azure NSG rule must not open SSH/RDP from the internet
checks.rationale: An inbound Allow rule from source * / Internet to port 22 or 3389 exposes admin access.
checks.fix: Restrict source_address_prefix to known ranges; do not Allow * / Internet on 22/3389.

checks.title: Kubernetes containers must not run privileged
checks.rationale: Privileged containers can escape to the host node.
checks.fix: Set security_context.privileged = false and drop unnecessary Linux capabilities.

checks.title: Kubernetes pods must not use host networking
checks.rationale: host_network gives the pod access to the node's network namespace, bypassing network policy.
checks.fix: Set host_network = false in the pod spec.
